title: School Notebooks 5-pack

adjustment.analysis: No known drivers for the target week: no events, no price change, no promotion. The baseline already reflects recent trends and seasonality. The noise-adjusted effect of Father's Day (week before) is x1.0, indicating no meaningful lift. The past promotion at 30% off lifted sales to x2.86, but that was a deep discount in a different context. The classical uplift model's x1.0 is well-calibrated here. No evidence of demand shift from the last week (6 units, no event). Median and spreads remain unchanged.
